2154: One of the central characters of the series, she is a famous, but timid, character designer best known for a cartoonish dog named Maromi. She carries a plush toy copy of Maromi everywhere.
2155: Maromi is a popular Sanrio-esque mascot created by Tsukiko Sagi. A pink dog with big black eyes and droopy ears, Maromi is considered rather cute in appearance. The little plush toy is seen by the audience as life-like because it gets up, walks around and talks to Tsukiko.
2156: The enigmatic figure the series revolves around. He appears as a grinning, baseball cap-wearing juvenile who travels on golden inline skates and attacks people with a gold-colored metal baseball bat that is curiously bent.
5130: Keiichi Ikari is a detective in charge of the Shounen Bat case alongside Mitsuhiro Maniwa. In comparison to his coworker, Maniwa, Keiichi is very old fashioned and prefers to do things simplistically. He's extremely uptight and easily frustrated.
5131: Mitsuhiro works with Keiichi Ikari in the Metal Bat case, and is often the more understanding of the two. He has a very gentle personality and questions Keiichi's hastiness in his mind.
8718: Masami is the father of Taeko, and a corrupt police officer. He accepts bribes and even takes loans from the Yakuza, but when the time comes to pay them back, he begs for more time.
9255: Harumi Chouno is a young woman employed as a researcher at a university, as well as Yuuichi Taira's tutor. Harumi suffers from dissociative identity disorder, and her alter ego is a sex worker named Maria.
12387: The sickly yet loving and determined wife of Detective Keiichi Ikari, who finds her own way to confront Shounen Bat.
13595: Zebra is a cheerful and funny young man introduced in the eight episode of the show, when he meets up with his online friends Fuyubachi and Kamome to commit group suicide.
13596: Kamome is a young girl who along with Fuyubachi and Zebra meet to commit group suicide. She is left behind when the two men realize she is a child, though she follows them anyway.
13597: Fuyubachi is an old man introduced in the eight episode of the show, who groups up with Zebra and Kamome to commit group suicide.
16422: Yuuichi Taira is a narcissistic student who stars in Episode 2. He is the fourth victim of Golden Bat. Prior to the events of Golden Bat, Yuuichi was popular at school, and ran for class president.
16423: Shougo Ushiyama is described by Yuuichi as a 'fat country bumpkin'. They’re running against each other in the student council elections. While Yuuichi has a dislike towards him, Shougo appears to consider the other boy a friend in some regard.
16520: Akio Kawazu is a freelance journalist. Heavy in debt to pay for the hospital bills of an elderly man that was hit by Kawazu's car, Akio struggles to find a big story.
22374: Taeko is Masami Hirukawa's runaway teenage daughter who left her home during the onslaught of a violent storm. She is the focus of Episode 6.
22375: First seen writing a series of extremely complex mathematical equations on the asphalt, this sage is doubtless the most mysterious human character in the whole series.
34458: A hero of a manga in the fourth episode of the series.
